scope: Five isolated stages derive the exact original iPhone crypto owner and wire a single original initialization into actual early SYSCTL and later OSKext loading. Eighteen sanitized owner-state paths and 33 compiled ARM64 paths use explicit original-initializer/POST/private-PRNG peers. Original start wrappers and native table registration execute. The independent source-provider entry/POST field is absent; original crypto code remains unchanged. Strict prelink and production loader/container readback pass with 25 rejection controls. Original POST/provider ABI/runtime, full OSKext and policy initialization, root/Data authentication and hardware are unqualified. No phone operations.
